d: Team Spidey stops invisible Rhino from doing sneaky crimes across town; Team Spidey teams up with hero Squirrel Girl to stop Green Goblin's Naughty Nutty Ray.

st: Warbler Get Your Geetar!; The Littlest Striker
d: When Sneezel is too afraid to ask to be a part of a concert, Wheezelene steps in to help; Powerhouse Pete doubts Cuckoo Loca's abilities when she joins in a soccer game.
While cleaning up the Funhouse after a big, silly windstorm, Donald discovers an adorable baby gorilla; it's picture day, but Pluto and Teddy just can't stay still.
With MeMo's help, BaBa learns how to be gentle with animals and delicate objects; MeMo and BaBa play with a cardboard tube and learn to look at the world together.
Bluey and Bingo help Uncle Stripe and Bandit play squash and spend the day with Nana; Bingo has to learn to play alone.

st: Owlette and the Battling HQs; Gekko and the Mayhem at the Museum
d: Night Ninja creates a fortress and plans to take down the PJ Masks; Gekko can't stop Romeo from unleashing his Big Box of Bad.
